faq.q: Can I build a house on vacant ALR land in Abbotsford?
faq.a: On ALR land, the Agricultural Land Commission generally allows one main house of 500 m² or less, with no more than 1,000 m² of fill for building it; a secondary suite only inside that house; and one additional detached home of up to 90 m² (properties of 40 ha or less) or 186 m² (over 40 ha). City zoning must also allow the home, and anything larger or more needs the Commission's approval.

faq.q: How do I check zoning, plan designation and permit areas for an Abbotsford lot?
faq.a: The City's Development Planning page directs current zoning, future land uses and development permit areas to the City's property information search or a property search in WebMap.
